verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents multiple integration paths (low-code Flow, Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links, Mobile SDK, Unified API) plus a public Node.js SDK, test cards, and a full testing sandbox, suggesting a quick path to a working payment flow. However, the evidence pack shows only one language SDK (Node.js) explicitly, no actual copy-paste code snippets are visible in the pack, and there's no independent report confirming a sub-day integration time. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK/code-sample evidence (e.g. Python, PHP, Java, Ruby), visible copy-paste code blocks in docs, and third-party/developer corroboration of integration speed.
